## Settings

| Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| train_ratio | `train_ratio` | Number | `0.8` |   | The run | Train ratio. |
| val_ratio | `val_ratio` | Number | `0.1` |   | The run | Validation ratio. |
| test_ratio | `test_ratio` | Number | `0.1` |   | The run | Test ratio. |
| boundary_policy | `boundary_policy` | Choice | `targets_within_partition` | `targets_within_partition`, `window_rows` | The run | Window boundary policy. |
| train_end_source_row | `train_end_source_row` | Integer | `-1` |   | The run | Exclusive Train source-row boundary (-1 uses ratios) |
| val_end_source_row | `val_end_source_row` | Integer | `-1` |   | The run | Exclusive Validation source-row boundary (-1 uses ratios) |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).
